{{Quote|Lord Daiman's fighters use precision-guided munitions-but for the most part, the guidance comes from the weapons themselves. To keep the vehicles small and nimble, as few systems are built on board as possible.|Ler-Laar Joom|<ref name="Knight Errant" />}}
'''Daimanate starfighters''' were small single-seat [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] deployed by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. They had twin ion engines, were fast and maneuverable, and shaped like a tri-pronged dart. In [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], these fighters were deployed in an unsuccessful attack on Sith Lord [[Odion]]'s space station "[[The Spike (space station)|The Spike]]." During the [[Raid on The Spike]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]] hijacked one of these starfighters and infiltrated the station after ejecting in her space suit.
